controls.title: Privileged MFA and sensitive-action step-up
controls.gap: Native MFA/WebAuthn/TOTP and step-up authentication are not implemented.
controls.validation: MFA enrollment/login/recovery + privileged-action step-up tests; cross-path auth bypass tests.
controls.notes: Existing P1 reinforced by this reference cycle. Prefer phishing-resistant WebAuthn/passkeys where practical.

controls.title: Session reauthentication and inactivity policy
controls.gap: Server-side sessions are revocable and expire, but the default overall TTL is 24h and last_seen is not an inactivity timeout.
controls.validation: Policy tests for inactivity/reauthentication and risk events; token/session rotation tests.
controls.notes: Coordinate with SEC-AUTH-001 so UX/security semantics are designed once.

controls.title: Immutable GitHub Actions dependencies
controls.gap: External actions are referenced by mutable major tags.
controls.validation: Static workflow scan finds no external uses: reference pinned to a mutable vX/version tag; actionlint/zizmor and full CI pass.
controls.notes: Release workflow has packages:write, increasing impact of a compromised workflow dependency.

controls.title: Generic credential and secret scanning
controls.gap: PII quarantine is intentionally not a generic API key/token/cloud credential scanner.
controls.validation: Seed a synthetic detectable test credential in a test branch/fixture path and prove the scanner job fails without printing sensitive material.
controls.notes: Keep PII and credential scanning as separate controls.

controls.title: Private vulnerability disclosure route
controls.gap: SECURITY.md is placeholder boilerplate with fictional supported versions and no real private reporting channel.
controls.blocker: Owner must enable/test GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting or provide a monitored private security contact.
controls.validation: External non-collaborator can find and use the documented private route; owner confirms receipt and response workflow.
controls.notes: Do not invent an email address or advertise a reporting channel that is not actually monitored.

controls.title: Protected default branch and required checks
controls.gap: Existing audit identified default-branch governance as open; required checks must be enforced by repository settings.
controls.validation: Repository ruleset/branch-protection read proves PR requirement, required checks, and force-push/delete protections.
controls.notes: Administration setting; cannot be implemented by ordinary source-code patch.

controls.title: Database-enforced tenant isolation
controls.validation: PostgreSQL non-superuser RLS tests and pooled-connection reuse tests remain required in CI.
controls.notes: Application scoping plus ORM guard plus PostgreSQL RLS.

controls.title: PII quarantine for repository content and history
controls.validation: Tree gate and nightly full-history gate remain green; scanner configuration fails closed.
controls.notes: Verified control does not replace generic secret scanning.

controls.title: Browser/API security headers
controls.validation: Header middleware tests cover CSP, HSTS effective-HTTPS behavior, framing/content-type/referrer policies and safe Content-Disposition.
controls.notes: Defense in depth; TLS termination remains required.

controls.title: GDPR erasure preview and execution
controls.validation: Tenant/admin authorization, preview/execute parity, legal-hold and statutory-retention behavior stay covered.
controls.notes: Stronger than browser-local deletion because regulated records need classification and retention handling.

controls.title: PR-time dependency vulnerability review
controls.gap: Language-specific checks exist, but there is no repository-wide PR dependency-review gate.
controls.validation: Dependency review job passes on normal changes and blocks a controlled moderate-or-higher vulnerable dependency test.

controls.title: Independent production key-encryption key
controls.gap: Existing audit identified local KEK fallback coupled to JWT secret unless independent KEK is provisioned.
controls.validation: Provision independent KEK/KMS, recovery/rotation drill, then production config rejects fallback.
controls.notes: Provision first; hard-failing before key availability can create outage.

controls.title: Customer portal capability-token hardening
controls.gap: Existing audit identified long-lived plaintext capability token with revocation but no expiry.
controls.validation: Owner decides standing-link product contract; then hash-at-rest/expiry/regeneration tests as approved.
controls.notes: Product semantics must be decided before changing link lifetime.

controls.title: Connect-time outbound destination validation
controls.gap: Existing SSRF guard blocks normal private/reserved targets but prior audit found DNS validation/connection TOCTOU residual.
controls.validation: DNS rebinding/redirect tests prove the socket connects only to a validated public address; validation fails closed.
controls.notes: Cross-repository reinforcement from Paperless and Twenty.
